description: Independent publication test settings. Paths resolve relative to this file; test setup explicitly overrides writable locations with temporary directories.

settings.persistenceConfig: Independent test persistence configuration. Test setup supplies an isolated storage root.
settings.visitorOrigin: Origin used for test visitor URLs. Runtime tests explicitly supply their actual server origin.
settings.legacySourceRoot: Directory containing legacy source fixtures for ingestion tests.
settings.legacyPublicRoot: Directory containing public asset fixtures for ingestion tests.
settings.preparedRoot: Preparation output location. Tests explicitly override it with an isolated temporary directory.
